title: Don't quit your job until side project revenue beats it for 6 months
summary: Pieter Levels advises against going full time on a side project right away. Build it while you have stable job income, and only consider quitting once the project's revenue has exceeded your salary for six consecutive months.

principles.text: Build your side project while you still have stable income from a job.
principles.quote: build your side project while you have stable income from a job

principles.text: Only consider quitting once side project revenue has surpassed your job income for 6 months.
principles.quote: when the revenue from the side project surpasses your job for 6 months consider quitting

principles.text: Don't quit your job just to go full time on a side project.
principles.quote: I see a lot of ppl quit their job and just go full time on a side project which I wouldn’t recommend
